stages.title: IQ gets you hired. EQ gets you promoted.

parts.visual:
Technical skills (IQ) are a baseline requirement. But at the executive level, Emotional Intelligence (EQ) is what separates decent managers from elite leaders.

The 4 Pillars of EQ:
1. Self-Awareness: Knowing your own triggers.
2. Self-Management: Not screaming when you get triggered.
3. Social Awareness: Reading the room and sensing team burnout.
4. Relationship Management: Inspiring and resolving conflict.
parts.audio: Technical skills get you hired, but Emotional Intelligence gets you promoted. Elite leaders master self-awareness, self-management, and social awareness.

questions.question: A director has a brilliant strategic mind (High IQ) but throws tantrums when things go wrong, terrifying the team. What is the diagnosis?
options: High IQ, Low EQ (Specifically failing at Self-Management).
questions.correct_answer: High IQ, Low EQ (Specifically failing at Self-Management).
questions.explanation: A leader who cannot control their own emotional reactions will never be able to control a complex organization in a crisis.

questions.question: Listen to the executive. What pillar of EQ is this?
questions.tts_text: I noticed the engineering team has been unusually quiet this week. They seem burnt out from the launch. Let's give them Friday off.
questions.explanation: Social awareness is the ability to read the unspoken emotional temperature of a room or a team.

questions.question: Why is 'Self-Awareness' the foundation of all Emotional Intelligence?
options: Because if you don't know your own flaws and emotional triggers, you cannot stop yourself from reacting badly to them.
Because it makes you look smart.
questions.correct_answer: Because if you don't know your own flaws and emotional triggers, you cannot stop yourself from reacting badly to them.
questions.explanation: You cannot manage what you do not measure. If you are blind to your own arrogance, you cannot fix it.

questions.question: How does high EQ affect 'Relationship Management' during a conflict?
options: It allows the leader to scream louder.
It allows the leader to de-escalate the ego, find common ground, and focus the fighting parties on a shared objective.
It makes the leader ignore the conflict.
questions.correct_answer: It allows the leader to de-escalate the ego, find common ground, and focus the fighting parties on a shared objective.
questions.explanation: Elite executives are master diplomats. They navigate office politics by understanding what truly motivates the people involved.

pairs.match: Conscious knowledge of one's own character and feelings
The ability to understand and share the feelings of another
An event that causes a strong emotional reaction
